# PP-002 Marketplace Content Templates

These templates are internal drafting aids. A completed draft is not publication authorization.

## Buying Guide

1. Reader scenario and decision to make.
2. Essential workflow requirements.
3. Evaluation criteria and exclusions.
4. Evidence-backed options or a clear statement that no option is approved.
5. Data, privacy, support, cost, and migration questions.
6. Affiliate disclosure adjacent to any qualifying link.
7. Sources, fact-check date, owner review, and update trigger.

## Comparison

1. Scope and comparable use case.
2. Criteria table with first-party sources for every factual entry.
3. What each option does not address.
4. Cost and contract information only when verified and dated.
5. No winner unless methodology and evidence support one.
6. Disclosure and relationship statement.

## Review

1. What was actually evaluated and what was not.
2. Method, environment, and date.
3. Observed strengths and limitations.
4. No fabricated hands-on use, ratings, or outcomes.
5. Disclosure, sources, reviewer, and update trigger.

## Department Page

1. Clear department purpose and reader situations.
2. Practical planning guidance before product links.
3. Published resources and approved recommendations only.
4. Explicitly state when offers or attribution are unverified.
5. Related guides and internal links.
6. Page-specific title, description, canonical URL, headings, and structured-data review.
